Mosaic Wellness| JS, Python, SQL | Mumbai, India | ONSITE | Full-Time

I am looking to hire 2 Product Engineers for my team. Experience between 1-4 years. Should have solid dev skills in JS/TS and should have interest in the product/business aspects of the tools you are building.

This is a role where you own the tech and the product aspect of the tool. You will be building 0-1 platforms in the platform team (internal or consumer facing) for the brands in our org. We have 5 brands currently. Massive learning opportunity if you want to understand the business behind the products you build.

This is is a full time role in Mumbai, India. Mosaic Wellness is the parent company of brands like ManMatters|BeBodywise|OurLittleJoys.

Send a mail to ayush.pawar@mosaicwellness.in. Please include a short introduction, your resume or your portfolio and your github.
